formats.key: deposit(bytes32 depositor,bytes32 recipient,bytes32 inputToken,bytes32 outputToken,uint256 inputAmount,uint256 outputAmount,uint256 destinationChainId,bytes32 exclusiveRelayer,uint32 quoteTimestamp,uint32 fillDeadline,uint32 exclusivityParameter,bytes message)
effects: Pulls inputAmount of inputToken from the signer (msg.sender) into the SpokePool via safeTransferFrom, spending the signer's allowance.
If inputToken is WETH and msg.value > 0, takes msg.value native ETH (must equal inputAmount) and wraps it instead of pulling WETH.
Creates a deposit: a relayer is to send outputAmount of outputToken to recipient on destinationChainId before fillDeadline.
The depositor (which may differ from the signer) is credited: gets the refund if unfilled and can speed up (change output amount, recipient, message).
An exclusive relayer may be given exclusive fill rights until the exclusivity deadline.
formats.shown: Bridge inputAmount of the input token to a raw bytes32 recipient on a named destination chain, with the relayer's output amount and token, native value, depositor (refund rights) and fill deadline.

findings.title: deposit: native ETH deposits show 'Bridge X WETH' while the signer pays ETH, not WETH.
findings.evidence: SpokePool._depositV3: `if (params.inputToken == address(wrappedNativeToken).toBytes32() && msg.value > 0) { ... wrappedNativeToken.deposit{ value: msg.value }(); }`. Case 1: mined effect is 0.007203865762570825 native ETH out; screen shows 'Amount to Bridge 0.007203865762570825 WETH' and 'Native Value Sent 0.007203865762570825 ETH'; the sentence says 'Bridge 0.0072... WETH'.
findings.fix: Add {@.value} to the interpolatedIntent (e.g. '...; paid with {@.value} native') or label the amount 'Amount to Bridge (paid from Native Value if set)', so the two lines do not look like two payments.

findings.title: deposit: chain IDs in neither ifNotIn list show two 'Destination Chain' fields, one unresolved enum.
findings.evidence: descriptor: chainId field hidden only for the 14 enum ids; enum field hidden only for [1,10,56,137,324,8453,42161,43114,59144]. A destination such as 534352 (Scroll) or 7777777 (Zora) matches neither, so both fields show and the enum has no entry.
findings.fix: Add every other supported Across chain to the enum field's ifNotIn list (or to the enum), so exactly one field shows per chain.

findings.title: deposit: bytes32 recipient shows as 32-byte padded hex with no name resolution.
findings.evidence: descriptor field `recipient` format raw; case 13 screen 'Recipient 0x00000000000000000000000000e96139cd1ef3f86919f00306fda9e1fc37f127'; reader: 'looks like yours but the format is unusual'. A [12:32] slice would be wrong for Solana recipients.
findings.fix: None reliable today: the destination may be non-EVM. Optionally note in the label that it is a padded address.

findings.title: deposit: exclusive relayer and exclusivity window are hidden; they only affect who can fill and when.
findings.evidence: descriptor: exclusiveRelayer and exclusivityParameter `visible: never`; SpokePool._depositV3 sets exclusivityDeadline from exclusivityParameter. No signer asset moves differently.
findings.fix: Optional: show exclusiveRelayer with addressName when non-zero.

cases.notes: 0.003242593 WETH out to SpokePool shown as Amount to Bridge.
Native ETH out shown in Native Value Sent; Amount to Bridge says WETH, the reader still understood ETH was paid.

formats.key: depositNow(bytes32 depositor,bytes32 recipient,bytes32 inputToken,bytes32 outputToken,uint256 inputAmount,uint256 outputAmount,uint256 destinationChainId,bytes32 exclusiveRelayer,uint32 fillDeadlineOffset,uint32 exclusivityParameter,bytes message)
effects: Pulls inputAmount of inputToken from the signer into the SpokePool, or takes equal native ETH and wraps it when inputToken is WETH and value is sent.
Creates a deposit with quoteTimestamp = now and fillDeadline = now + fillDeadlineOffset: a relayer is to send outputAmount of outputToken to recipient on destinationChainId.
The depositor gets the refund if unfilled and can speed up the deposit.
formats.shown: Bridge inputAmount to a raw bytes32 recipient on a named chain, with the relayer's output amount and token, native value, depositor and a fill window duration.

findings.title: depositNow: with native value sent, the sentence says WETH is bridged while ETH is paid.
findings.evidence: SpokePool._depositV3 wraps msg.value when inputToken is WETH; descriptor shows 'Amount to Bridge' via tokenPath inputToken.[12:32] (WETH) next to a separate '@.value' field.
findings.fix: Add {@.value} to the interpolatedIntent or relabel the amount to say it is paid from native value when set.

findings.title: depositNow: chain IDs in neither ifNotIn list show both destination fields, one unresolved enum.
findings.evidence: descriptor: the two destinationChainId fields' ifNotIn lists cover only 23 ids; any other id (e.g. 534352) shows both.
findings.fix: Extend the enum field's ifNotIn list to every chain the chainId format resolves.

findings.title: depositNow: bytes32 recipient, and output token and amount for non-EVM chains, show raw.
findings.evidence: case 10 (Solana): 'Recipient 0x0000...07fa03...', 'Relayer Must Send 249800000', 'Output Token (dest.) 0xc6fa7af3...'. descriptor recipient format raw.
findings.fix: None today for non-EVM destinations.

findings.title: depositNow: exclusive relayer and exclusivity parameter are hidden.
findings.evidence: descriptor: exclusiveRelayer, exclusivityParameter `visible: never`; they only gate who fills first.
findings.fix: Optional: show exclusiveRelayer when non-zero.

effects: Delegatecalls each data[i] into the SpokePool itself with the signer as msg.sender and msg.value 0 (non-payable); each nested deposit pulls its tokens from the signer.
Reverts everything if any call fails.
formats.shown: A batch notice plus each nested SpokePool call decoded with its own screen.

findings.title: multicall: nested SpokePool calls outside this descriptor (e.g. fillRelay) cannot be decoded.
findings.evidence: MultiCallerUpgradeable.multicall: `address(this).delegatecall(data[i])` accepts any SpokePool function; the descriptor covers only deposit and speed-up selectors, while fill functions pull output tokens from msg.sender.
findings.fix: Add formats for relayer fill functions, or accept that wallets fall back for them.

formats.key: speedUpDeposit(bytes32 depositor,uint256 depositId,uint256 updatedOutputAmount,bytes32 updatedRecipient,bytes updatedMessage,bytes depositorSignature)
effects: Verifies the depositor's signature and emits RequestedSpeedUpDeposit; no assets move.
Lets relayers fill the depositor's deposit depositId with the new output amount, recipient and message.
formats.shown: Request an update of a deposit id for a depositor: a raw new output amount and a raw bytes32 new recipient.

findings.title: speedUpDeposit: new output amount is raw; its token is not in the calldata.
findings.evidence: SpokePool.speedUpDeposit only takes depositId; the output token is in the original deposit event. Descriptor 'New Output (raw)' format raw; case 6 '305000000000000000'.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor; the label already says raw.

findings.title: speedUpDeposit: new recipient shows as 32-byte padded hex.
findings.evidence: descriptor updatedRecipient format raw; case 6 'New Recipient 0x0000000000000000000000005cf0e7fe...'.
findings.fix: None reliable for non-EVM recipients.

formats.key: unsafeDeposit(bytes32 depositor,bytes32 recipient,bytes32 inputToken,bytes32 outputToken,uint256 inputAmount,uint256 outputAmount,uint256 destinationChainId,bytes32 exclusiveRelayer,uint256 depositNonce,uint32 quoteTimestamp,uint32 fillDeadline,uint32 exclusivityParameter,bytes message)
effects: Pulls inputAmount of inputToken from the signer, or takes equal native ETH and wraps it when inputToken is WETH and value is sent.
Creates a deposit whose id is keccak(msg.sender, depositor, depositNonce); a relayer is to send outputAmount of outputToken to recipient on destinationChainId.
The depositor gets the refund if unfilled; a reused nonce can make the deposit unfillable until it is refunded after the deadline.
formats.shown: Bridge with a chosen nonce: amount, native value, chain, raw recipient, relayer output, depositor, fill deadline, nonce.

findings.title: unsafeDeposit: with native value, the sentence says WETH is bridged while ETH is paid.
findings.evidence: SpokePool._depositV3 wraps msg.value; case 8 shows 'Amount to Bridge 0.005 WETH' and 'Native Value Sent 0.005 ETH'.

findings.title: unsafeDeposit: chain IDs in neither ifNotIn list show both destination fields.
findings.evidence: descriptor destinationChainId chainId/enum fields with incomplete complementary ifNotIn lists.
findings.fix: Extend the enum field's ifNotIn list.

findings.title: unsafeDeposit: nothing says a reused nonce can leave the deposit unfillable until the refund.
findings.evidence: SpokePool.unsafeDeposit natspec: a colliding deposit id 'would make this deposit unfillable... the depositor would subsequently receive a refund'. The intent only says 'with a chosen deposit nonce'.
findings.fix: Optional: label 'Deposit Nonce (reuse makes the deposit unfillable)'.

findings.title: unsafeDeposit: bytes32 recipient shows as padded hex.

findings.fix: None reliable for non-EVM destinations.
